source.ref: b7e9832851d6 (fix(cloud-contract): refuse dot and empty segments in gateway paths), no later fix to the changed code

rationale: A small, tested fix with no known issue in the changed code: the gateway path pattern refuses dot and empty segments, which a URL would resolve out of the provider's prefix, and keeps dots inside a segment. Percent-encoded dots were already refused, since % is outside the allowed characters.
